causes_found: librespot 0.8 reset_options() clears repeat on every new selection; the app never reapplied it
a stale GET after a repeat change restored the old icon; Spotify refusals were ignored
reapplying a mix from the same track never refreshed the Queue panel (no track change)
song page Shake/Random/Discovery only opened a preview that required Apply
Android had no repeat control; librespot also drops track repeat on skip

repeat_and_mix_tests: repeat change sent with the active device and kept through a stale GET
repeat reapplied after a new selection; selection reset not shown as off
track repeat sent; skipping ahead leaves queue repeat
refused repeat change reverted with a message
applied mix shown as the queue without a Spotify request, discoveries marked
an applied mix is not a plain selection; a plain selection clears it
Shake applies now with the current song first and a new order
Random applies from the current song; forgetting clears the modes
cancelled discovery never replaces the queue
ui_tests: player bar order: Shake, Random, previous, play, next, Repeat, Discovery
song page controls visible together and applying directly
repeat cycles off -> queue -> track -> off with its icon
collection that is playing applies modes to the current queue; another collection does not

interruption: A power outage stopped an in-progress desktop build. git fsck found no errors, sources had no truncation or NUL bytes, cargo confirmed the Android native libraries were complete, and the desktop was rebuilt from a clean build directory before tests and packaging.
icon_review: Track repeat first drew a small 1 inside the arrows that was illegible at 24 px; it now draws smaller arrows with a readable 1 beside them on both platforms.
